message: John, I'm really worried about Ethan. He's been so distant lately. Is there anything you've noticed in your interactions with him?
I've been feeling really lost lately. It's like I don't know who I am anymore. The things I confessed to you weigh heavily on me.

I'm really struggling right now. Ever since I had to leave my job at the tech startup a few months ago, I've been feeling completely lost and unsure of my direction in life. Also, I don't know whether it's by coincidence or not, at the same time, I run into relationship crisis with my girl friend. Everything are all messed up in my life...
Thank you for the talk today. I feel a bit better having shared my struggles with someone.
John, I heard there's a youth group event coming up. Do you think it would be good for Ethan?
I'm not sure I can face my parents after what I've done. I'm so ashamed.
Can we count on you for the charity event next month? Ethan would love to see you there.
Sometimes I think volunteering is the only thing that makes sense to me anymore.
Ethan's been asking about confession times. I think he's looking for guidance.
I appreciate the work you do, John. It's not easy to open up, but I'm glad I can talk to you.
